definitions.explanation: Something that originates or branches off from a main source. Used in linguistics (derived words), business (spin-off products), and general contexts (secondary outcomes).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{派生|はせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are issues that derived from this problem.

examples.japanese: {派生|はせい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Derivative products were released one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧さまざまな⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{派生|はせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Various projects branched off from a single idea.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier ({派生|はせい}～) or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to indicate that something derives from something else. Common in academic, technical, and business contexts.

In linguistics, ⟦{派生語|はせいご}→派生語：23852_haseigo⟧ means "derived word" or "derivative."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {派生|はせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to derive, to branch off
- {派生|はせい}{語|ご}: derived word, derivative
- {派生|はせい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: derivative product, spin-off product
- ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{派生|はせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to derive from ~
